seo6.nl:
Deze medium kunststof pallet 1100x1100 is veelzijdig inzetbaar in magazijnen, productie en distributie. De pallet meet 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, weegt 11,7 kg en heeft een open dek op drie onderlatten. De pallet draagt 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch en 250 kg in de stelling.

Waar de medium kunststof pallet 1100x1100 wordt gebruikt

1100 x 1100 mm is een van de zes palletmaten uit de internationale norm ISO 6780. Daarnaast is het de gangbare vierkante maat in Azië, onder meer in Japan en Korea. Bedrijven die naar deze markten verzenden of daar inkopen, houden zo één palletformaat in de hele keten. Een ander voordeel: een kunststof pallet heeft geen hittebehandeling of stempel nodig volgens de ISPM 15-norm voor houten verpakkingen. Deze medium kunststof pallet 1100x1100 is een praktische keuze voor zowel interne logistiek als export.

Belasting: 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch en 250 kg in de stelling

De statische belasting van 7.500 kg geldt wanneer de pallet op een vlakke, egale vloer staat, bijvoorbeeld bij blokstapeling. De dynamische belasting van 1.250 kg geldt daarentegen wanneer een heftruck of pompwagen de beladen pallet optilt en verplaatst. Tot slot geldt de stellingbelasting van 250 kg wanneer alleen de liggers van de stelling de pallet dragen.

Alle waarden gaan uit van een gelijkmatig verdeelde last. Puntlasten of een ongelijke verdeling verlagen de bruikbare capaciteit. Controleer de pallet daarom altijd aan de hand van uw werkelijke lading.

Open dek en drie onderlatten

Door het open dek kan vocht weglopen en kan lucht rond de lading circuleren. Drie onderlatten geven de pallet een stabiele basis op de vloer en op de liggers van de stelling. Het gewicht van 11,7 kg past bij een robuuste constructie voor herhaald gebruik. Zoals al onze standaardpallets is hij gemaakt van bijna 100% gerecycled kunststof (een mix van HDPE en PP), neemt hij geen vocht op en heeft hij geen spijkers of splinters.

Andere uitvoeringen van de medium kunststof pallet 1100x1100

Zoekt u een andere uitvoering? Denk dan aan de medium uitvoering met open dek en zes onderlatten. Die weegt 13,2 kg en draagt 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch en 250 kg in de stelling. Daarnaast is er de light uitvoering met open dek en drie onderlatten. Deze weegt 8,4 kg en draagt 2.500 kg statisch en 1.000 kg dynamisch. Ook leverbaar is de heavy uitvoering met open dek en drie onderlatten, die weegt 19,9 kg en draagt 7.500 kg statisch, 2.000 kg dynamisch en 1.000 kg in de stelling.
seo6.en:
This 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, weighs 11.7 kg and has an open deck on three runners. It carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet

1100 x 1100 mm is one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. It is also the common square format in Asia, including Japan and Korea. Companies that ship to or buy from these markets therefore use it to keep one pallet format throughout the supply chain. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1100x1100 medium pallet is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,250 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 250 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and three runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Three runners give the pallet a stable base on the floor and on rack beams. Its weight of 11.7 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with an open deck and six runners, which weighs 13.2 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 8.4 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the heavy version with an open deck and three runners weighs 19.9 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 2,000 kg dynamic and 1,000 kg in racking.
seo6.de:
Diese Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1100x1100 ist vielseitig einsetzbar in Lager, Produktion und Distribution. Sie misst 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, wiegt 11,7 kg und hat ein offenes Deck auf drei Kufen. Sie trägt 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 250 kg im Regal.

Wo die Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1100x1100 zum Einsatz kommt

1100 x 1100 mm gehört zu den sechs Palettenmaßen der internationalen Norm ISO 6780. Außerdem ist es das übliche quadratische Format in Asien, unter anderem in Japan und Korea. Unternehmen, die in diese Märkte liefern oder dort einkaufen, nutzen daher ein einheitliches Palettenformat in der gesamten Lieferkette. Ein weiterer Vorteil: Eine Kunststoffpalette braucht keine Hitzebehandlung und keine Kennzeichnung nach dem ISPM-15-Standard für Holzverpackungen. Diese Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1100x1100 ist eine praktische Wahl für die interne Logistik und den Export.

Tragfähigkeit: 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 250 kg im Regal

Die statische Belastung von 7.500 kg gilt, wenn die Palette auf einem ebenen Boden steht, zum Beispiel bei der Blocklagerung. Die dynamische Belastung von 1.250 kg gilt dagegen, wenn ein Gabelstapler oder Hubwagen die beladene Palette anhebt und bewegt. Schließlich gilt die Regalbelastung von 250 kg, wenn nur die Regaltraversen die Palette tragen.

Alle Werte gehen von einer gleichmäßig verteilten Last aus. Punktlasten oder eine ungleichmäßige Verteilung verringern jedoch die nutzbare Traglast. Prüfen Sie die Palette daher immer anhand Ihrer tatsächlichen Ladung.

Offenes Deck und drei Kufen

Durch das offene Deck kann Feuchtigkeit ablaufen und Luft um die Ladung zirkulieren. Drei Kufen geben der Palette einen stabilen Stand auf dem Boden und auf den Regaltraversen. Das Gewicht von 11,7 kg steht für eine robuste Bauweise im Dauereinsatz. Wie alle unsere Standardpaletten besteht sie aus fast 100 % recyceltem Kunststoff (einer Mischung aus HDPE und PP), nimmt keine Feuchtigkeit auf und hat weder Nägel noch Splitter.

Die Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1100x1100 im Vergleich

Sie suchen eine andere Ausführung? Dann kommt die Medium-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und sechs Kufen infrage. Sie wiegt 13,2 kg und trägt 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 250 kg im Regal. Außerdem gibt es die Light-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Diese wiegt 8,4 kg und trägt 2.500 kg statisch und 1.000 kg dynamisch. Ebenfalls erhältlich ist die Heavy-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Sie wiegt 19,9 kg und trägt 7.500 kg statisch, 2.000 kg dynamisch und 1.000 kg im Regal.
seo6.fr:
Cette palette plastique Medium 1100x1100 s’utilise au quotidien en entrepôt, en production et en distribution. Elle mesure 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, pèse 11,7 kg et dispose d’un plateau ajouré sur trois semelles. Elle supporte 7.500 kg en statique, 1.250 kg en dynamique et 250 kg en rayonnage.

Où utiliser la palette plastique Medium 1100x1100

Le format 1100 x 1100 mm fait partie des six dimensions de palettes de la norme internationale ISO 6780. C’est aussi le format carré courant en Asie, notamment au Japon et en Corée. Les entreprises qui expédient vers ces marchés ou s’y approvisionnent conservent ainsi un seul format de palette dans toute la chaîne. Autre avantage : une palette en plastique ne nécessite ni traitement thermique ni marquage selon la norme ISPM 15 pour les emballages en bois. Cette palette plastique Medium 1100x1100 constitue un choix pratique pour la logistique interne comme pour l’export.

Charges : 7.500 kg en statique, 1.250 kg en dynamique et 250 kg en rayonnage

La charge statique de 7.500 kg s’applique lorsque la palette repose sur un sol plat et régulier, par exemple en gerbage. Pour la manutention, en revanche, la charge dynamique de 1.250 kg s’applique lorsqu’un chariot ou un transpalette soulève la palette chargée. Enfin, la charge en rayonnage de 250 kg s’applique lorsque seules les lisses du rayonnage portent la palette.

Toutes les valeurs supposent une charge répartie uniformément. Cependant, les charges ponctuelles ou une répartition inégale réduisent la capacité utile. Vérifiez donc toujours la palette par rapport à votre charge réelle.

Plateau ajouré et trois semelles

Grâce au plateau ajouré, l’humidité s’écoule et l’air circule autour de la charge. Trois semelles donnent à la palette une assise stable au sol et sur les lisses du rayonnage. Son poids de 11,7 kg traduit une construction robuste pour un usage répété. Comme toutes nos palettes standard, elle est fabriquée en plastique recyclé à près de 100 % (un mélange de HDPE et de PP). Elle n’absorbe pas l’humidité et ne présente ni clous ni échardes.

Autres versions de la palette plastique Medium 1100x1100

Vous cherchez une autre configuration ? Pensez alors à la version Medium à plateau ajouré et six semelles. Elle pèse 13,2 kg et supporte 7.500 kg en statique, 1.250 kg en dynamique et 250 kg en rayonnage. Il existe aussi la version Light à plateau ajouré et trois semelles, qui pèse 8,4 kg et supporte 2.500 kg en statique et 1.000 kg en dynamique. Enfin, la version Heavy à plateau ajouré et trois semelles pèse 19,9 kg et supporte 7.500 kg en statique, 2.000 kg en dynamique et 1.000 kg en rayonnage.
seo6.it:
Questo pallet in plastica Medium 1100x1100 si usa ogni giorno in magazzino, in produzione e nella distribuzione. Misura 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, pesa 11,7 kg e ha un piano superiore aperto su tre slitte. Ha una portata statica di 7.500 kg, dinamica di 1.250 kg e su scaffale di 250 kg.

Dove si usa il pallet in plastica Medium 1100x1100

Il formato 1100 x 1100 mm è una delle sei misure di pallet della norma internazionale ISO 6780. Inoltre è il formato quadrato più diffuso in Asia, per esempio in Giappone e in Corea. Le aziende che spediscono verso questi mercati o vi acquistano mantengono così un unico formato di pallet lungo tutta la filiera. Un pallet in plastica, poi, non richiede trattamento termico né marchio secondo la norma ISPM 15 per gli imballaggi in legno. Questo pallet in plastica Medium 1100x1100 è una scelta pratica per la logistica interna e l’export.

Portata statica di 7.500 kg, dinamica di 1.250 kg e su scaffale di 250 kg

La portata statica di 7.500 kg vale quando il pallet poggia su un pavimento piano e regolare, per esempio nello stoccaggio a catasta. Durante la movimentazione, invece, la portata dinamica di 1.250 kg vale quando un carrello elevatore o un transpallet solleva il pallet carico. Infine, la portata su scaffale di 250 kg vale quando solo i correnti della scaffalatura sostengono il pallet.

Tutti i valori si riferiscono a un carico distribuito in modo uniforme. Tuttavia, carichi concentrati o una distribuzione irregolare riducono la portata utile. Verificate quindi sempre il pallet in base al vostro carico reale.

Piano superiore aperto e tre slitte

Grazie al piano aperto, l’umidità defluisce e l’aria circola intorno al carico. Tre slitte danno al pallet un appoggio stabile a terra e sui correnti della scaffalatura. Il peso di 11,7 kg riflette una costruzione robusta per l’uso ripetuto. Come tutti i nostri pallet standard, è realizzato in plastica riciclata quasi al 100% (una miscela di HDPE e PP), non assorbe umidità e non ha chiodi né schegge.

Altre versioni del pallet in plastica Medium 1100x1100

Cercate una configurazione diversa? Allora considerate la versione Medium con piano aperto e sei slitte, che pesa 13,2 kg e ha una portata statica di 7.500 kg, dinamica di 1.250 kg e su scaffale di 250 kg. In alternativa, la versione Light con piano aperto e tre slitte pesa 8,4 kg e ha una portata statica di 2.500 kg e dinamica di 1.000 kg. Infine, la versione Heavy con piano aperto e tre slitte pesa 19,9 kg e ha una portata statica di 7.500 kg, dinamica di 2.000 kg e su scaffale di 1.000 kg.
seo6.es:
Este palet de plástico Medium 1100x1100 sirve para el uso diario en almacén, producción y distribución. Mide 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, pesa 11,7 kg y tiene una superficie superior abierta sobre tres patines. Soporta 7.500 kg de carga estática, 1.250 kg de carga dinámica y 250 kg en estantería.

Dónde se utiliza el palet de plástico Medium 1100x1100

El formato 1100 x 1100 mm es una de las seis medidas de palet de la norma internacional ISO 6780. Además, es el formato cuadrado habitual en Asia, por ejemplo en Japón y Corea. Las empresas que envían a estos mercados o compran en ellos mantienen así un único formato de palet en toda la cadena de suministro. Asimismo, un palet de plástico no necesita tratamiento térmico ni marcado según la norma ISPM 15 para embalajes de madera. Este palet de plástico Medium 1100x1100 es una opción práctica para la logística interna y la exportación.

Carga: 7.500 kg estática, 1.250 kg dinámica y 250 kg en estantería

La carga estática de 7.500 kg se aplica cuando el palet descansa sobre un suelo plano y nivelado, por ejemplo en apilado en bloque. Durante la manipulación, en cambio, la carga dinámica de 1.250 kg se aplica cuando una carretilla o una transpaleta levanta el palet cargado. Por último, la carga en estantería de 250 kg se aplica cuando solo los largueros de la estantería sostienen el palet.

Todos los valores parten de una carga distribuida de forma uniforme. Sin embargo, las cargas puntuales o un reparto desigual reducen la capacidad útil. Por lo tanto, compruebe siempre el palet según su carga real.

Superficie superior abierta y tres patines

Gracias a la superficie abierta, la humedad se escurre y el aire circula alrededor de la carga. Tres patines dan al palet un apoyo estable en el suelo y sobre los largueros de la estantería. Su peso de 11,7 kg refleja una construcción robusta para el uso repetido. Como todos nuestros palets estándar, está fabricado con plástico casi 100% reciclado (una mezcla de HDPE y PP), no absorbe humedad y no tiene clavos ni astillas.

Otras versiones del palet de plástico Medium 1100x1100

¿Busca otra configuración? Entonces considere la versión Medium con superficie abierta y seis patines, que pesa 13,2 kg y soporta 7.500 kg de carga estática, 1.250 kg de carga dinámica y 250 kg en estantería. También está disponible la versión Light con superficie abierta y tres patines, que pesa 8,4 kg y soporta 2.500 kg de carga estática y 1.000 kg de carga dinámica. Por último, la versión Heavy con superficie abierta y tres patines pesa 19,9 kg y soporta 7.500 kg de carga estática, 2.000 kg de carga dinámica y 1.000 kg en estantería.

Belasting: 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch en 250 kg in de stelling

Alle waarden gaan uit van een gelijkmatig verdeelde last. Puntlasten of een ongelijke verdeling verlagen de bruikbare capaciteit. Controleer de pallet daarom altijd aan de hand van uw werkelijke lading.

Open dek en drie onderlatten

seo6.en:
This 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, weighs 11.7 kg and has an open deck on three runners. It carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet

1100 x 1100 mm is one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. It is also the common square format in Asia, including Japan and Korea. Companies that ship to or buy from these markets therefore use it to keep one pallet format throughout the supply chain. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1100x1100 medium pallet is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,250 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 250 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and three runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Three runners give the pallet a stable base on the floor and on rack beams. Its weight of 11.7 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with an open deck and six runners, which weighs 13.2 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 8.4 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the heavy version with an open deck and three runners weighs 19.9 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 2,000 kg dynamic and 1,000 kg in racking.

1100 x 1100 mm gehört zu den sechs Palettenmaßen der internationalen Norm ISO 6780. Außerdem ist es das übliche quadratische Format in Asien, unter anderem in Japan und Korea. Unternehmen, die in diese Märkte liefern oder dort einkaufen, nutzen daher ein einheitliches Palettenformat in der gesamten Lieferkette. Ein weiterer Vorteil: Eine Kunststoffpalette braucht keine Hitzebehandlung und keine Kennzeichnung nach dem ISPM-15-Standard für Holzverpackungen. Diese Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1100x1100 ist eine praktische Wahl für die interne Logistik und den Export.

Tragfähigkeit: 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 250 kg im Regal

Die statische Belastung von 7.500 kg gilt, wenn die Palette auf einem ebenen Boden steht, zum Beispiel bei der Blocklagerung. Die dynamische Belastung von 1.250 kg gilt dagegen, wenn ein Gabelstapler oder Hubwagen die beladene Palette anhebt und bewegt. Schließlich gilt die Regalbelastung von 250 kg, wenn nur die Regaltraversen die Palette tragen.

Alle Werte gehen von einer gleichmäßig verteilten Last aus. Punktlasten oder eine ungleichmäßige Verteilung verringern jedoch die nutzbare Traglast. Prüfen Sie die Palette daher immer anhand Ihrer tatsächlichen Ladung.

Offenes Deck und drei Kufen

Durch das offene Deck kann Feuchtigkeit ablaufen und Luft um die Ladung zirkulieren. Drei Kufen geben der Palette einen stabilen Stand auf dem Boden und auf den Regaltraversen. Das Gewicht von 11,7 kg steht für eine robuste Bauweise im Dauereinsatz. Wie alle unsere Standardpaletten besteht sie aus fast 100 % recyceltem Kunststoff (einer Mischung aus HDPE und PP), nimmt keine Feuchtigkeit auf und hat weder Nägel noch Splitter.

Außerdem gibt es die Light-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Diese wiegt 8,4 kg und trägt 2.500 kg statisch und 1.000 kg dynamisch. Ebenfalls erhältlich ist die Heavy-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Sie wiegt 19,9 kg und trägt 7.500 kg statisch, 2.000 kg dynamisch und 1.000 kg im Regal.

This 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 3 runners serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, weighs 12.3 kg and has an open deck on three runners. It carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 3 runners

1100 x 1100 mm is one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. It is also the common square format in Asia, including Japan and Korea. Companies that ship to or buy from these markets therefore use it to keep one pallet format throughout the supply chain. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1100x1100 medium pallet with 3 runners is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,250 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 250 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and three runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Three runners give the pallet a stable base on the floor and on rack beams. Its weight of 12.3 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 3 runners

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with an open deck and six runners, which weighs 13.2 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking. seo6.en:
This 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, weighs 13.2 kg and has an open deck on six runners. It carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners

1100 x 1100 mm is one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. It is also the common square format in Asia, including Japan and Korea. Companies that ship to or buy from these markets therefore use it to keep one pallet format throughout the supply chain. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1100x1100 medium pallet with 6 runners is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,250 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 250 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and six runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Six runners support the pallet over a larger area than three runners. Its weight of 13.2 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with an open deck and three runners, which weighs 11.7 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking. Alternatively, the heavy version with an open deck and six runners weighs 22 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 2,000 kg dynamic and 1,250 kg in racking. In addition, the light version with an open deck and nine feet weighs 6.8 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Tragfähigkeit: 7.500 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 250 kg im Regal

Alle Werte gehen von einer gleichmäßig verteilten Last aus. Punktlasten oder eine ungleichmäßige Verteilung verringern jedoch die nutzbare Traglast. Prüfen Sie die Palette daher immer anhand Ihrer tatsächlichen Ladung.

Ebenfalls erhältlich ist die Light-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und neun Füßen. Sie wiegt 6,8 kg und trägt 2.500 kg statisch und 1.000 kg dynamisch.

seo6.en:
This 1100x1100x150 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, weighs 13.1 kg and has an open deck on six runners. It carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1100x1100x150 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners

1100 x 1100 mm is one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. It is also the common square format in Asia, including Japan and Korea. Companies that ship to or buy from these markets therefore use it to keep one pallet format throughout the supply chain. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1100x1100x150 medium pallet with 6 runners is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,250 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 250 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and six runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Six runners support the pallet over a larger area than three runners. Its weight of 13.1 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1100x1100x150 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with an open deck and three runners, which weighs 11.7 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking. Alternatively, the heavy version with an open deck and six runners weighs 22 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 2,000 kg dynamic and 1,250 kg in racking. In addition, the light version with an open deck and nine feet weighs 6.8 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

seo6.en:
This 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1100 x 1100 x 150 mm, weighs 13.2 kg and has an open deck on six runners. It carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners

1100 x 1100 mm is one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. It is also the common square format in Asia, including Japan and Korea. Companies that ship to or buy from these markets therefore use it to keep one pallet format throughout the supply chain. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1100x1100 medium pallet with 6 runners is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,250 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 250 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and six runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Six runners support the pallet over a larger area than three runners. Its weight of 13.2 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1100x1100 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with an open deck and three runners, which weighs 11.7 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 250 kg in racking. Alternatively, the heavy version with an open deck and six runners weighs 22 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 2,000 kg dynamic and 1,250 kg in racking. In addition, the light version with an open deck and nine feet weighs 6.8 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Alle Werte gehen von einer gleichmäßig verteilten Last aus. Punktlasten oder eine ungleichmäßige Verteilung verringern jedoch die nutzbare Traglast. Prüfen Sie die Palette daher immer anhand Ihrer tatsächlichen Ladung.

Offenes Deck und sechs Kufen

This 1140x1140 medium plastic pallet with 3 runners serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1140 x 1140 x 150 mm, weighs 13.6 kg and has an open deck on three runners. It carries 7,500 kg static, 1,375 kg dynamic and 300 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1140x1140 medium plastic pallet with 3 runners

The square 1140 x 1140 mm format matches the CP3 and CP9 formats of the chemical industry. As a result, it is a common choice wherever goods move on CP-sized pallets in the process industry. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1140x1140 medium pallet with 3 runners is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 7,500 kg static, 1,375 kg dynamic and 300 kg in racking

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,375 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 300 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and three runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Three runners give the pallet a stable base on the floor and on rack beams. Its weight of 13.6 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1140x1140 medium plastic pallet with 3 runners

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with an open deck and six runners, which weighs 14.3 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,375 kg dynamic and 300 kg in racking. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 9.7 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the heavy version with an open deck and three runners weighs 22.4 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 2,000 kg dynamic and 1,250 kg in racking.

seo6.en:
This 1140x1140 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1140 x 1140 x 150 mm, weighs 14.3 kg and has an open deck on six runners. It carries 7,500 kg static, 1,375 kg dynamic and 300 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1140x1140 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners

The square 1140 x 1140 mm format matches the CP3 and CP9 formats of the chemical industry. As a result, it is a common choice wherever goods move on CP-sized pallets in the process industry. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1140x1140 medium pallet with 6 runners is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 7,500 kg static, 1,375 kg dynamic and 300 kg in racking

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,375 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 300 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and six runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Six runners support the pallet over a larger area than three runners. Its weight of 14.3 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1140x1140 medium plastic pallet with 6 runners

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with an open deck and three runners, which weighs 13.6 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,375 kg dynamic and 300 kg in racking. Alternatively, the heavy version with an open deck and six runners weighs 25.1 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 2,000 kg dynamic and 1,250 kg in racking. In addition, the light version with an open deck and nine feet weighs 7.2 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Die dynamische Belastung von 1.375 kg gilt dagegen, wenn ein Gabelstapler oder Hubwagen die beladene Palette anhebt und bewegt. Alle Werte gehen von einer gleichmäßig verteilten Last aus. Punktlasten oder eine ungleichmäßige Verteilung verringern jedoch die nutzbare Traglast. Prüfen Sie die Palette daher immer anhand Ihrer tatsächlichen Ladung.

Offenes Deck und sechs Kufen

Durch das offene Deck kann Feuchtigkeit ablaufen und Luft um die Ladung zirkulieren. Sechs Kufen stützen die Palette auf einer größeren Fläche als drei Kufen. Ebenfalls erhältlich ist die Light-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und neun Füßen. Sie wiegt 7,2 kg und trägt 2.500 kg statisch und 1.000 kg dynamisch.

The static load of 7,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. Open deck and six runners

seo6.en:
This 1200x800x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet keeps shipments light, which suits export and one-way transport. It measures 1200 x 800 x 150 mm, weighs 5.4 kg and has an open deck on nine feet. It carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Where to use the 1200x800x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet

The 1200 x 800 mm footprint is the Euro pallet size, the most common pallet format in European retail and logistics. It is also one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. Because most European warehouses, racks and trucks work with this size, the pallet fits smoothly into existing processes. As a light pallet, it keeps the shipping weight low, which helps to limit freight costs on export shipments. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1200x800x150 light pallet with 9 feet is a practical choice for export.

Load capacity: 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic

The static load of 2,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,000 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Q-Pall does not specify this pallet for unsupported pallet-rack storage. Therefore, store it on the floor or on a fully supporting surface.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and nine feet

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Furthermore, the nine feet make the pallet nestable: empty pallets fit into each other, which saves space in storage and on return transport. At 5.4 kg, one person can easily lift and position the pallet. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE, PP and LDPE), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1200x800x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the light version with a closed deck and nine feet, which weighs 6.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 7.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. Cette palette Light 1200x800x150 à 9 pieds allège les expéditions et convient donc à l’export et au transport à usage unique. Elle mesure 1200 x 800 x 150 mm, pèse 5,1 kg et dispose d’un plateau ajouré sur neuf pieds. Elle supporte 2.500 kg en statique et 1.000 kg en dynamique.

Où utiliser la palette Light 1200x800x150 à 9 pieds

Le format 1200 x 800 mm est celui de la palette Europe, le format de palette le plus répandu dans la distribution et la logistique européennes. Il fait également partie des six dimensions de palettes de la norme internationale ISO 6780. Comme la plupart des entrepôts, des rayonnages et des camions européens travaillent avec ce format, la palette s’intègre facilement dans les processus existants. En tant que palette Light, elle limite le poids expédié, ce qui réduit les frais de transport à l’export. Autre avantage : une palette en plastique ne nécessite ni traitement thermique ni marquage selon la norme ISPM 15 pour les emballages en bois. Cette palette Light 1200x800x150 à 9 pieds constitue un choix pratique pour l’export.

Charges : 2.500 kg en statique et 1.000 kg en dynamique

La charge statique de 2.500 kg s’applique lorsque la palette repose sur un sol plat et régulier, par exemple en gerbage. Pour la manutention, en revanche, la charge dynamique de 1.000 kg s’applique lorsqu’un chariot ou un transpalette soulève la palette chargée. Cette palette n’est pas prévue pour le stockage en rayonnage sans support. Posez-la donc au sol ou sur une surface qui la soutient entièrement.

Toutes les valeurs supposent une charge répartie uniformément. Cependant, les charges ponctuelles ou une répartition inégale réduisent la capacité utile. Vérifiez donc toujours la palette par rapport à votre charge réelle.

Plateau ajouré et neuf pieds

Grâce au plateau ajouré, l’humidité s’écoule et l’air circule autour de la charge. Par ailleurs, les neuf pieds rendent la palette emboîtable : les palettes vides s’emboîtent les unes dans les autres. Vous gagnez ainsi de la place au stockage et lors du transport retour. Avec seulement 5,1 kg, une seule personne peut facilement soulever et placer la palette. Comme toutes nos palettes standard, elle est fabriquée en plastique recyclé à près de 100 % (un mélange de HDPE, de PP et de LDPE). Elle n’absorbe pas l’humidité et ne présente ni clous ni échardes.

Questo pallet Light 1200x800x150 con 9 piedi alleggerisce le spedizioni ed è quindi adatto all’export e al trasporto a perdere. Misura 1200 x 800 x 150 mm, pesa 5,1 kg e ha un piano superiore aperto su nove piedi. Ha una portata statica di 2.500 kg e dinamica di 1.000 kg.

Dove si usa il pallet Light 1200x800x150 con 9 piedi

Il formato 1200 x 800 mm è quello dell’europallet, il formato di pallet più diffuso nella distribuzione e nella logistica europee. Inoltre è una delle sei misure di pallet della norma internazionale ISO 6780. Poiché la maggior parte dei magazzini, delle scaffalature e dei camion europei lavora con questa misura, il pallet si inserisce facilmente nei processi esistenti. Essendo un pallet Light, contiene il peso della spedizione e quindi aiuta a ridurre i costi di trasporto all’estero. Un pallet in plastica, poi, non richiede trattamento termico né marchio secondo la norma ISPM 15 per gli imballaggi in legno. Questo pallet Light 1200x800x150 con 9 piedi è una scelta pratica per l’export.

Portata statica di 2.500 kg e dinamica di 1.000 kg

La portata statica di 2.500 kg vale quando il pallet poggia su un pavimento piano e regolare, per esempio nello stoccaggio a catasta. Durante la movimentazione, invece, la portata dinamica di 1.000 kg vale quando un carrello elevatore o un transpallet solleva il pallet carico. Piano superiore aperto e nove piedi

Grazie al piano aperto, l’umidità defluisce e l’aria circola intorno al carico. Inoltre, i nove piedi rendono il pallet incastrabile: i pallet vuoti si infilano l’uno nell’altro. Così risparmiate spazio in magazzino e nel trasporto di ritorno. Con soli 5,1 kg, una sola persona può sollevare e posizionare il pallet con facilità. Come tutti i nostri pallet standard, è realizzato in plastica riciclata quasi al 100% (una miscela di HDPE, PP e LDPE), non assorbe umidità e non ha chiodi né schegge.

This 1200x800x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet keeps shipments light, which suits export and one-way transport. It measures 1200 x 800 x 150 mm, weighs 5.4 kg and has an open deck on nine feet. It carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Where to use the 1200x800x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet

The 1200 x 800 mm footprint is the Euro pallet size, the most common pallet format in European retail and logistics. It is also one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. As a light pallet, it keeps the shipping weight low, which helps to limit freight costs on export shipments. Therefore, store it on the floor or on a fully supporting surface.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and nine feet

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Furthermore, the nine feet make the pallet nestable: empty pallets fit into each other, which saves space in storage and on return transport. At 5.4 kg, one person can easily lift and position the pallet. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE, PP and LDPE), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

seo6.en:
This 1200x800 light plastic pallet keeps shipments light, which suits export and one-way transport. It measures 1200 x 800 x 150 mm, weighs 6.3 kg and has a closed deck on nine feet. It carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Where to use the 1200x800 light plastic pallet

The 1200 x 800 mm footprint is the Euro pallet size, the most common pallet format in European retail and logistics. It is also one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. Because most European warehouses, racks and trucks work with this size, the pallet fits smoothly into existing processes. As a light pallet, it keeps the shipping weight low, which helps to limit freight costs on export shipments. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1200x800 light pallet is a practical choice for export.

Load capacity: 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic

The static load of 2,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,000 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Q-Pall does not specify this pallet for unsupported pallet-rack storage. Therefore, store it on the floor or on a fully supporting surface.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Closed deck and nine feet

The closed deck offers a flat, continuous surface for small items, bags and cartons. It is also easy to clean. Furthermore, the nine feet make the pallet nestable: empty pallets fit into each other, which saves space in storage and on return transport. At 6.3 kg, one person can easily lift and position the pallet. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE, PP and LDPE), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1200x800 light plastic pallet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the light version with an open deck and nine feet, which weighs 5.1 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 7.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the light version with a closed deck and three runners weighs 7.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Das geschlossene Deck bietet eine ebene, durchgehende Fläche für kleine Produkte, Säcke und Kartons. Außerdem lässt es sich leicht reinigen. This 1200x800x149 light pallet with 9 feet is a practical choice for export.

Load capacity: 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic

Closed deck and nine feet

The closed deck offers a flat, continuous surface for small items, bags and cartons. It is also easy to clean. seo6.en:
This 1200x800 light plastic pallet with 9 feet keeps shipments light, which suits export and one-way transport. It measures 1200 x 800 x 150 mm, weighs 6.6 kg and has a closed deck on nine feet. It carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Where to use the 1200x800 light plastic pallet with 9 feet

The 1200 x 800 mm footprint is the Euro pallet size, the most common pallet format in European retail and logistics. It is also one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. Because most European warehouses, racks and trucks work with this size, the pallet fits smoothly into existing processes. As a light pallet, it keeps the shipping weight low, which helps to limit freight costs on export shipments. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1200x800 light pallet with 9 feet is a practical choice for export.

Load capacity: 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic

The static load of 2,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,000 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Q-Pall does not specify this pallet for unsupported pallet-rack storage. Therefore, store it on the floor or on a fully supporting surface.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Closed deck and nine feet

The closed deck offers a flat, continuous surface for small items, bags and cartons. It is also easy to clean. Furthermore, the nine feet make the pallet nestable: empty pallets fit into each other, which saves space in storage and on return transport. At 6.6 kg, one person can easily lift and position the pallet. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE, PP and LDPE), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1200x800 light plastic pallet with 9 feet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the light version with an open deck and nine feet, which weighs 5.1 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 7.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the light version with a closed deck and three runners weighs 7.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Das geschlossene Deck bietet eine ebene, durchgehende Fläche für kleine Produkte, Säcke und Kartons. Außerdem lässt es sich leicht reinigen. Deze medium kunststof pallet 1200x800 is veelzijdig inzetbaar in magazijnen, productie en distributie. De pallet meet 1200 x 800 x 145 mm, weegt 11,4 kg en heeft een open dek op drie onderlatten. De pallet draagt 5.000 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch en 450 kg in de stelling.

Waar de medium kunststof pallet 1200x800 wordt gebruikt

Het formaat 1200 x 800 mm is de maat van de europallet, het meest gebruikte palletformaat in de Europese retail en logistiek. Daarnaast is het een van de zes palletmaten uit de internationale norm ISO 6780. Omdat magazijnen, stellingen en vrachtwagens in Europa vaak op deze maat zijn ingericht, past de pallet naadloos in bestaande processen. Een ander voordeel: een kunststof pallet heeft geen hittebehandeling of stempel nodig volgens de ISPM 15-norm voor houten verpakkingen. Deze medium kunststof pallet 1200x800 is een praktische keuze voor zowel interne logistiek als export.

Belasting: 5.000 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch en 450 kg in de stelling

De statische belasting van 5.000 kg geldt wanneer de pallet op een vlakke, egale vloer staat, bijvoorbeeld bij blokstapeling. De dynamische belasting van 1.250 kg geldt daarentegen wanneer een heftruck of pompwagen de beladen pallet optilt en verplaatst. Tot slot geldt de stellingbelasting van 450 kg wanneer alleen de liggers van de stelling de pallet dragen.

Alle waarden gaan uit van een gelijkmatig verdeelde last. Puntlasten of een ongelijke verdeling verlagen de bruikbare capaciteit. Controleer de pallet daarom altijd aan de hand van uw werkelijke lading.

Open dek en drie onderlatten

Door het open dek kan vocht weglopen en kan lucht rond de lading circuleren. Drie onderlatten geven de pallet een stabiele basis op de vloer en op de liggers van de stelling. Het gewicht van 11,4 kg past bij een robuuste constructie voor herhaald gebruik. Zoals al onze standaardpallets is hij gemaakt van bijna 100% gerecycled kunststof (een mix van HDPE en PP), neemt hij geen vocht op en heeft hij geen spijkers of splinters.

Andere uitvoeringen van de medium kunststof pallet 1200x800

Zoekt u een andere uitvoering? Denk dan aan de medium uitvoering met gesloten dek en drie onderlatten. Die weegt 13,8 kg en draagt 5.000 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch en 650 kg in de stelling. Daarnaast is er de light uitvoering met open dek en drie onderlatten. Deze weegt 7,3 kg en draagt 2.500 kg statisch en 1.000 kg dynamisch. Ook leverbaar is de heavy uitvoering met open dek en drie onderlatten, die weegt 16,9 kg en draagt 7.500 kg statisch, 1.750 kg dynamisch en 1.000 kg in de stelling.
seo6.en:
This 1200x800 medium plastic pallet serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1200 x 800 x 145 mm, weighs 11.4 kg and has an open deck on three runners. It carries 5,000 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 450 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1200x800 medium plastic pallet

The 1200 x 800 mm footprint is the Euro pallet size, the most common pallet format in European retail and logistics. It is also one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. Because most European warehouses, racks and trucks work with this size, the pallet fits smoothly into existing processes. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1200x800 medium pallet is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 5,000 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 450 kg in racking

The static load of 5,000 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,250 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 450 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and three runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Three runners give the pallet a stable base on the floor and on rack beams. Its weight of 11.4 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1200x800 medium plastic pallet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with a closed deck and three runners, which weighs 13.8 kg and carries 5,000 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 650 kg in racking. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 7.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the heavy version with an open deck and three runners weighs 16.9 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,750 kg dynamic and 1,000 kg in racking.
seo6.de:
Diese Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1200x800 ist vielseitig einsetzbar in Lager, Produktion und Distribution. Sie misst 1200 x 800 x 145 mm, wiegt 11,4 kg und hat ein offenes Deck auf drei Kufen. Sie trägt 5.000 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 450 kg im Regal.

Wo die Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1200x800 zum Einsatz kommt

Das Format 1200 x 800 mm ist das Maß der Europalette und damit das gängigste Palettenformat im europäischen Handel und in der Logistik. Außerdem gehört es zu den sechs Palettenmaßen der internationalen Norm ISO 6780. Da die meisten europäischen Lager, Regale und Lkw mit diesem Maß arbeiten, fügt sich die Palette nahtlos in bestehende Abläufe ein. Ein weiterer Vorteil: Eine Kunststoffpalette braucht keine Hitzebehandlung und keine Kennzeichnung nach dem ISPM-15-Standard für Holzverpackungen. Diese Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1200x800 ist eine praktische Wahl für die interne Logistik und den Export.

Tragfähigkeit: 5.000 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 450 kg im Regal

Die statische Belastung von 5.000 kg gilt, wenn die Palette auf einem ebenen Boden steht, zum Beispiel bei der Blocklagerung. Die dynamische Belastung von 1.250 kg gilt dagegen, wenn ein Gabelstapler oder Hubwagen die beladene Palette anhebt und bewegt. Schließlich gilt die Regalbelastung von 450 kg, wenn nur die Regaltraversen die Palette tragen.

Alle Werte gehen von einer gleichmäßig verteilten Last aus. Punktlasten oder eine ungleichmäßige Verteilung verringern jedoch die nutzbare Traglast. Prüfen Sie die Palette daher immer anhand Ihrer tatsächlichen Ladung.

Offenes Deck und drei Kufen

Durch das offene Deck kann Feuchtigkeit ablaufen und Luft um die Ladung zirkulieren. Drei Kufen geben der Palette einen stabilen Stand auf dem Boden und auf den Regaltraversen. Das Gewicht von 11,4 kg steht für eine robuste Bauweise im Dauereinsatz. Wie alle unsere Standardpaletten besteht sie aus fast 100 % recyceltem Kunststoff (einer Mischung aus HDPE und PP), nimmt keine Feuchtigkeit auf und hat weder Nägel noch Splitter.

Die Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1200x800 im Vergleich

Sie suchen eine andere Ausführung? Dann kommt die Medium-Ausführung mit geschlossenem Deck und drei Kufen infrage. Sie wiegt 13,8 kg und trägt 5.000 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 650 kg im Regal. Außerdem gibt es die Light-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Diese wiegt 7,3 kg und trägt 2.500 kg statisch und 1.000 kg dynamisch. Ebenfalls erhältlich ist die Heavy-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Sie wiegt 16,9 kg und trägt 7.500 kg statisch, 1.750 kg dynamisch und 1.000 kg im Regal.
seo6.fr:
Cette palette plastique Medium 1200x800 s’utilise au quotidien en entrepôt, en production et en distribution. Elle mesure 1200 x 800 x 145 mm, pèse 11,4 kg et dispose d’un plateau ajouré sur trois semelles. Elle supporte 5.000 kg en statique, 1.250 kg en dynamique et 450 kg en rayonnage.

Où utiliser la palette plastique Medium 1200x800

Le format 1200 x 800 mm est celui de la palette Europe, le format de palette le plus répandu dans la distribution et la logistique européennes. Il fait également partie des six dimensions de palettes de la norme internationale ISO 6780. Comme la plupart des entrepôts, des rayonnages et des camions européens travaillent avec ce format, la palette s’intègre facilement dans les processus existants. Autre avantage : une palette en plastique ne nécessite ni traitement thermique ni marquage selon la norme ISPM 15 pour les emballages en bois. Cette palette plastique Medium 1200x800 constitue un choix pratique pour la logistique interne comme pour l’export.

Charges : 5.000 kg en statique, 1.250 kg en dynamique et 450 kg en rayonnage

La charge statique de 5.000 kg s’applique lorsque la palette repose sur un sol plat et régulier, par exemple en gerbage. Pour la manutention, en revanche, la charge dynamique de 1.250 kg s’applique lorsqu’un chariot ou un transpalette soulève la palette chargée. Enfin, la charge en rayonnage de 450 kg s’applique lorsque seules les lisses du rayonnage portent la palette.

Toutes les valeurs supposent une charge répartie uniformément. Cependant, les charges ponctuelles ou une répartition inégale réduisent la capacité utile. Vérifiez donc toujours la palette par rapport à votre charge réelle.

Plateau ajouré et trois semelles

Grâce au plateau ajouré, l’humidité s’écoule et l’air circule autour de la charge. Trois semelles donnent à la palette une assise stable au sol et sur les lisses du rayonnage. Son poids de 11,4 kg traduit une construction robuste pour un usage répété. Comme toutes nos palettes standard, elle est fabriquée en plastique recyclé à près de 100 % (un mélange de HDPE et de PP). Elle n’absorbe pas l’humidité et ne présente ni clous ni échardes.

Autres versions de la palette plastique Medium 1200x800

Vous cherchez une autre configuration ? Pensez alors à la version Medium à plateau fermé et trois semelles. Elle pèse 13,8 kg et supporte 5.000 kg en statique, 1.250 kg en dynamique et 650 kg en rayonnage. Il existe aussi la version Light à plateau ajouré et trois semelles, qui pèse 7,3 kg et supporte 2.500 kg en statique et 1.000 kg en dynamique. Enfin, la version Heavy à plateau ajouré et trois semelles pèse 16,9 kg et supporte 7.500 kg en statique, 1.750 kg en dynamique et 1.000 kg en rayonnage.

Dove si usa il pallet in plastica Medium 1200x800

Il formato 1200 x 800 mm è quello dell’europallet, il formato di pallet più diffuso nella distribuzione e nella logistica europee. Inoltre è una delle sei misure di pallet della norma internazionale ISO 6780. Poiché la maggior parte dei magazzini, delle scaffalature e dei camion europei lavora con questa misura, il pallet si inserisce facilmente nei processi esistenti. Un pallet in plastica, poi, non richiede trattamento termico né marchio secondo la norma ISPM 15 per gli imballaggi in legno. Questo pallet in plastica Medium 1200x800 è una scelta pratica per la logistica interna e l’export.

Portata statica di 5.000 kg, dinamica di 1.250 kg e su scaffale di 450 kg

La portata statica di 5.000 kg vale quando il pallet poggia su un pavimento piano e regolare, per esempio nello stoccaggio a catasta. Durante la movimentazione, invece, la portata dinamica di 1.250 kg vale quando un carrello elevatore o un transpallet solleva il pallet carico. Infine, la portata su scaffale di 450 kg vale quando solo i correnti della scaffalatura sostengono il pallet.

Tutti i valori si riferiscono a un carico distribuito in modo uniforme. Tuttavia, carichi concentrati o una distribuzione irregolare riducono la portata utile. Verificate quindi sempre il pallet in base al vostro carico reale.

Piano superiore aperto e tre slitte

Grazie al piano aperto, l’umidità defluisce e l’aria circola intorno al carico. Tre slitte danno al pallet un appoggio stabile a terra e sui correnti della scaffalatura. Il peso di 11,4 kg riflette una costruzione robusta per l’uso ripetuto. Come tutti i nostri pallet standard, è realizzato in plastica riciclata quasi al 100% (una miscela di HDPE e PP), non assorbe umidità e non ha chiodi né schegge.

Altre versioni del pallet in plastica Medium 1200x800

Cercate una configurazione diversa? Allora considerate la versione Medium con piano chiuso e tre slitte, che pesa 13,8 kg e ha una portata statica di 5.000 kg, dinamica di 1.250 kg e su scaffale di 650 kg. In alternativa, la versione Light con piano aperto e tre slitte pesa 7,3 kg e ha una portata statica di 2.500 kg e dinamica di 1.000 kg. Infine, la versione Heavy con piano aperto e tre slitte pesa 16,9 kg e ha una portata statica di 7.500 kg, dinamica di 1.750 kg e su scaffale di 1.000 kg.
seo6.es:
Este palet de plástico Medium 1200x800 sirve para el uso diario en almacén, producción y distribución. Mide 1200 x 800 x 145 mm, pesa 11,4 kg y tiene una superficie superior abierta sobre tres patines. Soporta 5.000 kg de carga estática, 1.250 kg de carga dinámica y 450 kg en estantería.

Dónde se utiliza el palet de plástico Medium 1200x800

El formato 1200 x 800 mm es el del europalet, el formato de palet más extendido en la distribución y la logística europeas. Además, es una de las seis medidas de palet de la norma internacional ISO 6780. Como la mayoría de los almacenes, las estanterías y los camiones europeos trabajan con esta medida, el palet se integra fácilmente en los procesos existentes. Asimismo, un palet de plástico no necesita tratamiento térmico ni marcado según la norma ISPM 15 para embalajes de madera. Este palet de plástico Medium 1200x800 es una opción práctica para la logística interna y la exportación.

Carga: 5.000 kg estática, 1.250 kg dinámica y 450 kg en estantería

La carga estática de 5.000 kg se aplica cuando el palet descansa sobre un suelo plano y nivelado, por ejemplo en apilado en bloque. Durante la manipulación, en cambio, la carga dinámica de 1.250 kg se aplica cuando una carretilla o una transpaleta levanta el palet cargado. Por último, la carga en estantería de 450 kg se aplica cuando solo los largueros de la estantería sostienen el palet.

Todos los valores parten de una carga distribuida de forma uniforme. Sin embargo, las cargas puntuales o un reparto desigual reducen la capacidad útil. Por lo tanto, compruebe siempre el palet según su carga real.

Superficie superior abierta y tres patines

Gracias a la superficie abierta, la humedad se escurre y el aire circula alrededor de la carga. Tres patines dan al palet un apoyo estable en el suelo y sobre los largueros de la estantería. Su peso de 11,4 kg refleja una construcción robusta para el uso repetido. Como todos nuestros palets estándar, está fabricado con plástico casi 100% reciclado (una mezcla de HDPE y PP), no absorbe humedad y no tiene clavos ni astillas.

Otras versiones del palet de plástico Medium 1200x800

¿Busca otra configuración? Entonces considere la versión Medium con superficie cerrada y tres patines, que pesa 13,8 kg y soporta 5.000 kg de carga estática, 1.250 kg de carga dinámica y 650 kg en estantería. También está disponible la versión Light con superficie abierta y tres patines, que pesa 7,3 kg y soporta 2.500 kg de carga estática y 1.000 kg de carga dinámica. Por último, la versión Heavy con superficie abierta y tres patines pesa 16,9 kg y soporta 7.500 kg de carga estática, 1.750 kg de carga dinámica y 1.000 kg en estantería.

seo6.en:
This 1200x800 medium plastic pallet serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1200 x 800 x 145 mm, weighs 12 kg and has an open deck on three runners. It carries 5,000 kg static, 1,500 kg dynamic and 450 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1200x800 medium plastic pallet

The 1200 x 800 mm footprint is the Euro pallet size, the most common pallet format in European retail and logistics. It is also one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. Because most European warehouses, racks and trucks work with this size, the pallet fits smoothly into existing processes. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1200x800 medium pallet is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 5,000 kg static, 1,500 kg dynamic and 450 kg in racking

The static load of 5,000 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,500 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 450 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and three runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Three runners give the pallet a stable base on the floor and on rack beams. Its weight of 12 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1200x800 medium plastic pallet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with a closed deck and three runners, which weighs 13.8 kg and carries 5,000 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 650 kg in racking. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 7.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the heavy version with an open deck and three runners weighs 16.9 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,750 kg dynamic and 1,000 kg in racking.

Das Format 1200 x 800 mm ist das Maß der Europalette und damit das gängigste Palettenformat im europäischen Handel und in der Logistik. Außerdem gehört es zu den sechs Palettenmaßen der internationalen Norm ISO 6780. Da die meisten europäischen Lager, Regale und Lkw mit diesem Maß arbeiten, fügt sich die Palette nahtlos in bestehende Abläufe ein. Ein weiterer Vorteil: Eine Kunststoffpalette braucht keine Hitzebehandlung und keine Kennzeichnung nach dem ISPM-15-Standard für Holzverpackungen. Diese Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1200x800 ist eine praktische Wahl für die interne Logistik und den Export.

Tragfähigkeit: 5.000 kg statisch, 1.500 kg dynamisch und 450 kg im Regal

Die statische Belastung von 5.000 kg gilt, wenn die Palette auf einem ebenen Boden steht, zum Beispiel bei der Blocklagerung. Die dynamische Belastung von 1.500 kg gilt dagegen, wenn ein Gabelstapler oder Hubwagen die beladene Palette anhebt und bewegt. Schließlich gilt die Regalbelastung von 450 kg, wenn nur die Regaltraversen die Palette tragen.

Alle Werte gehen von einer gleichmäßig verteilten Last aus. Punktlasten oder eine ungleichmäßige Verteilung verringern jedoch die nutzbare Traglast. Prüfen Sie die Palette daher immer anhand Ihrer tatsächlichen Ladung.

Offenes Deck und drei Kufen

Durch das offene Deck kann Feuchtigkeit ablaufen und Luft um die Ladung zirkulieren. Drei Kufen geben der Palette einen stabilen Stand auf dem Boden und auf den Regaltraversen. Das Gewicht von 12 kg steht für eine robuste Bauweise im Dauereinsatz. Wie alle unsere Standardpaletten besteht sie aus fast 100 % recyceltem Kunststoff (einer Mischung aus HDPE und PP), nimmt keine Feuchtigkeit auf und hat weder Nägel noch Splitter.

Sie suchen eine andere Ausführung? Dann kommt die Medium-Ausführung mit geschlossenem Deck und drei Kufen infrage. Sie wiegt 13,8 kg und trägt 5.000 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 650 kg im Regal. Außerdem gibt es die Light-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Diese wiegt 7,3 kg und trägt 2.500 kg statisch und 1.000 kg dynamisch. Ebenfalls erhältlich ist die Heavy-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Sie wiegt 16,9 kg und trägt 7.500 kg statisch, 1.750 kg dynamisch und 1.000 kg im Regal.

Où utiliser la palette Medium 1200x800 à 3 semelles

Le format 1200 x 800 mm est celui de la palette Europe, le format de palette le plus répandu dans la distribution et la logistique européennes. Il fait également partie des six dimensions de palettes de la norme internationale ISO 6780. Comme la plupart des entrepôts, des rayonnages et des camions européens travaillent avec ce format, la palette s’intègre facilement dans les processus existants. Autre avantage : une palette en plastique ne nécessite ni traitement thermique ni marquage selon la norme ISPM 15 pour les emballages en bois. Cette palette Medium 1200x800 à 3 semelles constitue un choix pratique pour la logistique interne comme pour l’export.

Charges : 5.000 kg en statique, 1.500 kg en dynamique et 500 kg en rayonnage

Enfin, la charge en rayonnage de 500 kg s’applique lorsque seules les lisses du rayonnage portent la palette.

Dove si usa il pallet Medium 1200x800 con 3 slitte

Portata statica di 5.000 kg, dinamica di 1.500 kg e su scaffale di 500 kg

Piano superiore aperto e tre slitte

Il peso di 12 kg riflette una costruzione robusta per l’uso ripetuto. Open dek en drie onderlatten

Het gewicht van 11,4 kg past bij een robuuste constructie voor herhaald gebruik. Zoals al onze standaardpallets is hij gemaakt van bijna 100% gerecycled kunststof (een mix van HDPE en PP), neemt hij geen vocht op en heeft hij geen spijkers of splinters.

seo6.en:
This 1200x800 medium plastic pallet serves everyday use in warehouses, production and distribution. It measures 1200 x 800 x 145 mm, weighs 11.4 kg and has an open deck on three runners. It carries 5,000 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 450 kg in pallet racking.

Where to use the 1200x800 medium plastic pallet

The 1200 x 800 mm footprint is the Euro pallet size, the most common pallet format in European retail and logistics. It is also one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard. Because most European warehouses, racks and trucks work with this size, the pallet fits smoothly into existing processes. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1200x800 medium pallet is a practical choice for both internal logistics and export.

Load capacity: 5,000 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 450 kg in racking

The static load of 5,000 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,250 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Finally, the racking load of 450 kg applies when only the rack beams support the pallet.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and three runners

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Three runners give the pallet a stable base on the floor and on rack beams. Its weight of 11.4 kg reflects a robust construction for repeated use. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE and PP), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1200x800 medium plastic pallet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the medium version with a closed deck and three runners, which weighs 13.8 kg and carries 5,000 kg static, 1,250 kg dynamic and 650 kg in racking. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 7.3 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the heavy version with an open deck and three runners weighs 16.9 kg and carries 7,500 kg static, 1,750 kg dynamic and 1,000 kg in racking.

Diese Medium-Kunststoffpalette 1200x800 ist eine praktische Wahl für die interne Logistik und den Export.

Die dynamische Belastung von 1.250 kg gilt dagegen, wenn ein Gabelstapler oder Hubwagen die beladene Palette anhebt und bewegt. Schließlich gilt die Regalbelastung von 450 kg, wenn nur die Regaltraversen die Palette tragen.

Alle Werte gehen von einer gleichmäßig verteilten Last aus. Punktlasten oder eine ungleichmäßige Verteilung verringern jedoch die nutzbare Traglast. Prüfen Sie die Palette daher immer anhand Ihrer tatsächlichen Ladung.

Offenes Deck und drei Kufen

Durch das offene Deck kann Feuchtigkeit ablaufen und Luft um die Ladung zirkulieren. Drei Kufen geben der Palette einen stabilen Stand auf dem Boden und auf den Regaltraversen. Das Gewicht von 11,4 kg steht für eine robuste Bauweise im Dauereinsatz. Wie alle unsere Standardpaletten besteht sie aus fast 100 % recyceltem Kunststoff (einer Mischung aus HDPE und PP), nimmt keine Feuchtigkeit auf und hat weder Nägel noch Splitter.

Sie wiegt 13,8 kg und trägt 5.000 kg statisch, 1.250 kg dynamisch und 650 kg im Regal. Außerdem gibt es die Light-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Diese wiegt 7,3 kg und trägt 2.500 kg statisch und 1.000 kg dynamisch. Ebenfalls erhältlich ist die Heavy-Ausführung mit offenem Deck und drei Kufen. Sie wiegt 16,9 kg und trägt 7.500 kg statisch, 1.750 kg dynamisch und 1.000 kg im Regal.

This 1200x1000x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet keeps shipments light, which suits export and one-way transport. It measures 1200 x 1000 x 150 mm, weighs 6.8 kg and has an open deck on nine feet. It carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Where to use the 1200x1000x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet

1200 x 1000 mm is one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard and many people call it the industrial pallet format. It is widely used in industry and in the United Kingdom. In addition, it matches the CP1 and CP6 formats of the chemical industry. As a light pallet, it keeps the shipping weight low, which helps to limit freight costs on export shipments. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1200x1000x150 light pallet with 9 feet is a practical choice for export.

Load capacity: 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic

The static load of 2,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,000 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Q-Pall does not specify this pallet for unsupported pallet-rack storage. Therefore, store it on the floor or on a fully supporting surface.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Open deck and nine feet

The open deck lets moisture drain away and allows air to circulate around the load. Furthermore, the nine feet make the pallet nestable: empty pallets fit into each other, which saves space in storage and on return transport. At 6.8 kg, one person can easily lift and position the pallet. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE, PP and LDPE), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

In addition, the light version with a closed deck and three runners weighs 8.5 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Open deck and nine feet

seo6.en:
This 1200x1000x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet keeps shipments light, which suits export and one-way transport. It measures 1200 x 1000 x 150 mm, weighs 8.9 kg and has a closed deck on nine feet. It carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Where to use the 1200x1000x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet

1200 x 1000 mm is one of the six pallet sizes in the international ISO 6780 standard and many people call it the industrial pallet format. It is widely used in industry and in the United Kingdom. In addition, it matches the CP1 and CP6 formats of the chemical industry. As a light pallet, it keeps the shipping weight low, which helps to limit freight costs on export shipments. Another advantage is that a plastic pallet needs no heat treatment or stamp under the ISPM 15 standard for wood packaging. This 1200x1000x150 light pallet with 9 feet is a practical choice for export.

Load capacity: 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic

The static load of 2,500 kg applies when the pallet rests on a flat, level floor, for example in block stacking. The dynamic load of 1,000 kg applies when a forklift or pallet truck lifts and moves the loaded pallet. Q-Pall does not specify this pallet for unsupported pallet-rack storage. Therefore, store it on the floor or on a fully supporting surface.

All values assume an evenly distributed load. Point loads or uneven loading reduce the usable capacity, so always check the pallet against your actual load.

Closed deck and nine feet

The closed deck offers a flat, continuous surface for small items, bags and cartons. It is also easy to clean. Furthermore, the nine feet make the pallet nestable: empty pallets fit into each other, which saves space in storage and on return transport. At 8.9 kg, one person can easily lift and position the pallet. Like all our standard pallets, it is made of nearly 100% recycled plastic (a mix of HDPE, PP and LDPE), does not absorb moisture and has no nails or splinters.

Other versions of the 1200x1000x150 light plastic pallet with 9 feet

Would you prefer a different configuration? Then consider the light version with an open deck and nine feet, which weighs 6.8 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. Alternatively, the light version with an open deck and three runners weighs 8.5 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic. In addition, the light version with a closed deck and three runners weighs 8.5 kg and carries 2,500 kg static and 1,000 kg dynamic.

Dove si usa il pallet in plastica Medium 1140x1140

Il formato quadrato 1140 x 1140 mm corrisponde ai formati CP3 e CP9 dell’industria chimica. Per questo è una scelta comune ovunque la merce viaggi su pallet in formato CP nell’industria di processo. Un pallet in plastica, poi, non richiede trattamento termico né marchio secondo la norma ISPM 15 per gli imballaggi in legno. Questo pallet in plastica Medium 1140x1140 è una scelta pratica per la logistica interna e l’export.

Portata statica di 7.500 kg, dinamica di 1.375 kg e su scaffale di 200 kg

La portata statica di 7.500 kg vale quando il pallet poggia su un pavimento piano e regolare, per esempio nello stoccaggio a catasta. Durante la movimentazione, invece, la portata dinamica di 1.375 kg vale quando un carrello elevatore o un transpallet solleva il pallet carico. Infine, la portata su scaffale di 200 kg vale quando solo i correnti della scaffalatura sostengono il pallet.

Piano superiore aperto e tre slitte

Il peso di 15,4 kg riflette una costruzione robusta per l’uso ripetuto. Come tutti i nostri pallet standard, è realizzato in plastica riciclata quasi al 100% (una miscela di HDPE e PP), non assorbe umidità e non ha chiodi né schegge.
